purpose: Separate evidence-selection and reasoning difficulty from exact opaque-ID transcription errors without weakening either task.
reported_non_gating_diagnostics: gold cited spans per match and level
nearest other-public-ID Hamming distance for gold IDs

near_match_diagnostic.metric: Levenshtein distance from an unknown model citation to public IDs
near_match_diagnostic.interpretation: A close public ID supports a transcription-error diagnosis but never establishes intended evidence or changes the official prediction.

admission_rule: If every required gate passes, keep dataset bytes unchanged and optimize only evaluation/error attribution. Any future citation-surface redesign requires a matched ablation and a new version.
